character: A village resort in Kosciuszko National Park in the New South Wales Snowy Mountains, with lifts rising from Thredbo Village up the Crackenback Range towards the Main Range near Mt Kosciuszko. Its 672 m vertical is the largest lift-served vertical in Australia, and Thredbo is on the Ikon Pass.
learning: Reference note: Friday Flat at the foot of the mountain is Thredbo's dedicated beginner area, with a ski and snowboard school in the village. Confirm lesson products and 2027 prices.

source.note: Winter 2026. Closing: Thredbo wrapped up its 2026 winter on Sun 13 Sep 2026 with a pond skim (SnowBrains). Opening: all five major mainland resorts operated from opening weekend, Sat 6 Jun 2026 (https://snowbrains.com/australia-ski-season-2026-opening-weekend-perisher-thredbo-buller-falls-hotham/).

Winter 2025: the search summary says Thredbo opened Sat 7 Jun 2025 (result attribution uncertain — it may come from https://www.skiresort.info/snow-reports/seasonstart/australia/). Closing date not captured: a 2025 season wrap (https://www.mountainwatch.com/Snow-news/2025-season-wrap-long-consistent-and-pretty-damned-good/) says Perisher and Thredbo had closed lifts two days before it was published, but the summary gave no date.

season.typicalText: The season traditionally starts on the King's Birthday long weekend in early June (6 Jun 2026, 7 Jun 2025). The 2026 season ended early, on 13 Sep, in a very poor snow year.
season.notes: Southern Hemisphere: Piste season id 2026-27 is the June–October 2027 winter (the one the 2026-27 Ikon and Epic passes cover); 2025-26 is the 2026 winter and 2024-25 the 2025 winter. No 2027 opening or closing date was found as of 2026-09-30. Australian resorts traditionally open on the King's Birthday long weekend — in 2027 that is Sat 12 – Mon 14 June (calendar inference, not an announcement). 2026 was reported as Australia's shortest season on record; Thredbo closed on Sun 13 Sep 2026.
